android.desc: Intuitive, minimalistic notes widget with a built-in reminder. Are you tired of complicated apps with features you will never use? With this app you can add notes or set a reminder with just 1 click! You can create a note by writing directly into the widget, with just 1 click, right from your home screen (without opening another screen). You can also set "real reminders" on notes - not short beeps, but 1-minute-long ringing and much more. Problems with the app? Read the FAQ here!

quotes.text:
> ...getting to my to-do list on all smartphone platforms is a multi-step process

My Nexus unlocks as I pick it up and my todo list is displayed on and editable from the home screen (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=sk.mildev84.noteswidgetreminder&hl=en_GB). I take notes a lot more often since getting that set up.
